<!-- Nues: 404 page code. Edit here, not in embeds. -->
<script>
/* Old URLs (service renames, and the Services overview that moved from /services/main to /services) land here:
   forward them to the new pages straight away. Keep this as a fallback; the real fix is the 301 redirects in Site settings > Publishing. */
(function(){var m={'/services/nues-launch':'/services/design-development','/services/nues-build':'/services/webflow-development','/services/nues-seo':'/services/seo-aeo','/services/nues-plus':'/services/growth','/services/main':'/services'};var p=location.pathname.replace(/\/+$/,'').toLowerCase();if(m[p]){location.replace(m[p]+location.search+location.hash);}})();
</script>
<style>
/* Hero: striped green background with a soft glow near the top, like the design */
.notfound-hero{background-image:
repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.3) 0,rgba(0,0,0,.3) 2px,rgba(0,0,0,.08) 4px,rgba(0,0,0,0) 10px,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 42px,rgba(0,0,0,.3) 44px),
radial-gradient(36% 30% at 44% 30%,rgba(110,196,154,.5) 0%,rgba(110,196,154,.2) 50%,rgba(110,196,154,0) 100%),
radial-gradient(70% 45% at 50% 35%,rgba(60,140,100,.3) 0%,rgba(60,140,100,0) 100%),
linear-gradient(180deg,#142c21 0%,#163a29 10%,#184833 28%,#17462f 42%,#11392a 56%,#0c2b1e 65%,#0b2419 70%,#041009 84%,#030c08 100%)}
/* 4 0 4 tiles drop in on load; the 0 tips over as it lands */
.notfound-hero_tile{animation:nf-drop 1s .15s both;transition:translate .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.notfound-hero_tile.is-zero{animation-name:nf-tip;animation-duration:1.15s;animation-delay:.4s}
.notfound-hero_tile.is-right{animation-delay:.65s}
@media (hover:hover){.notfound-hero_tile:hover{translate:0 -10px}}
@keyframes nf-drop{
0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-140%);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.55,0,1,.45)}
50%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1)}
68%{transform:translateY(-7%);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.55,0,1,.45)}
84%{transform:translateY(0);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1)}
92%{transform:translateY(-1.5%)}
100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes nf-tip{
0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-160%) rotate(-90deg);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.55,0,1,.45)}
45%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-8%) rotate(-90deg);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.5,0,.75,0)}
70%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(6deg);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1)}
85%{transform:rotate(-2deg)}
100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.notfound-hero_tile{animation:none;transition:none}}
</style>
<!-- 404 intro: the 4 0 4 tiles fall from the sky, land on the floor and can be grabbed and thrown (Matter.js, page footer).
     The headline comes up word by word and the button follows. Without the script, or with reduced motion, the page keeps
     the static tile row and the CSS drop above. -->
<script>(function(){var d=document.documentElement;if(window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return;d.classList.add('nf-js');setTimeout(function(){if(!window.nfReady)d.classList.remove('nf-js');},4000);})();</script>
<style>
html.nf-js .notfound-hero{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
/* the backdrop fades up from black */
html.nf-js .notfound-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background-color:#030c08;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 1.2s ease}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero.is-in::before{opacity:0}
/* the copy sits centred in the space above the tiles */
html.nf-js .notfound-hero_main{padding-top:5.5rem;padding-bottom:calc(var(--s,1) * 288px)}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero_content h1{opacity:0}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero.is-split .notfound-hero_content h1{opacity:1}
.nf-w{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:0 .02em .1em;margin-bottom:-.1em}
.nf-w>span{display:inline-block;translate:0 110%;transition:translate 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) var(--d,0s)}
.notfound-hero.is-in .nf-w>span{translate:none}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero_content .cta-v2_button{opacity:0}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero.is-in .notfound-hero_content .cta-v2_button{animation:nfUp .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .85s both}
@keyframes nfUp{from{opacity:0;translate:0 16px}to{opacity:1;translate:none}}
/* tiles: the physics places them, so they only need a size here (set by the script) */
html.nf-js .notfound-hero_tiles{position:static;height:0;margin:0;aspect-ratio:auto}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero_tile{left:0;top:0;z-index:4;visibility:hidden;animation:none;transition:box-shadow .3s ease;border-radius:calc(var(--s,1) * 39px);cursor:grab;touch-action:none;will-change:transform;box-shadow:0 30px 50px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero_tile:hover{translate:none}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero_tile.is-on{visibility:visible}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero_tile.is-grab{cursor:grabbing;box-shadow:0 50px 70px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
html.nf-js .notfound-hero.is-grabbing{cursor:grabbing}
</style>
footer:
<!-- Nues: 404 page code. Edit here, not in embeds. -->
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/matter-js/0.19.0/matter.min.js"></script>
<script>
/* 404 intro (see the note in the page head). The 4 0 4 tiles are the page's own elements: they fall from the sky,
   land on the floor a little above the bottom edge and can be grabbed and thrown. */
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement, sec = document.querySelector('.notfound-hero');
  if (!root.classList.contains('nf-js') || !sec || !window.Matter) { root.classList.remove('nf-js'); return; }
  window.nfReady = true;
  var M = Matter, els = [].slice.call(sec.querySelectorAll('.notfound-hero_tile'));
  // Where each tile lands (share of the width), how it is tilted and spun, and when it drops (ms)
  var X = [.127, .5, .8], ANGLE = [-.07, .05, .08], SPIN = [.004, -.003, -.005], AT = [1000, 1200, 1550];
  var engine = M.Engine.create({ gravity: { y: 1.25 }, positionIterations: 10, velocityIterations: 8 }),
      world = engine.world, walls = [], bodies = [], timers = [], W = 0, H = 0, S = 1;

  // Headline: each word rises out of its own line
  var h1 = sec.querySelector('.notfound-hero_content h1');
  if (h1) {
    var words = h1.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/), t = .35;
    h1.textContent = '';
    words.forEach(function (w, i) {
      if (i) h1.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '));
      var o = document.createElement('span'), n = document.createElement('span');
      o.className = 'nf-w'; n.textContent = w;
      n.style.setProperty('--d', t.toFixed(2) + 's');
      t += /[.!?]$/.test(w) ? .15 : .08;
      o.appendChild(n); h1.appendChild(o);
    });
  }
  sec.classList.add('is-split');

  // Tile size: 1 at 1440px wide; phones get bigger tiles than a straight scale-down so the 4 0 4 still reads
  function scale() { var w = sec.clientWidth; return Math.min(1, w < 768 ? w / 1050 : Math.max(.26, w / 1440)); }
  function size(el) {
    var zero = el.classList.contains('is-zero');
    el.style.width = (zero ? 326 : 264) * S + 'px';
    el.style.height = (zero ? 264 : 325) * S + 'px';
  }
  function buildWalls() {
    walls.forEach(function (w) { M.Composite.remove(world, w); });
    W = sec.clientWidth; H = sec.clientHeight; var T = 400, o = { isStatic: true, friction: .6, restitution: .2 };
    walls = [M.Bodies.rectangle(W / 2, H - 24 * S + T / 2, W * 3, T, o),   // floor, a little above the bottom edge
             M.Bodies.rectangle(-T / 2, H / 2 - H, T, H * 4, o),           // left
             M.Bodies.rectangle(W + T / 2, H / 2 - H, T, H * 4, o),        // right
             M.Bodies.rectangle(W / 2, -H * 1.6 - T / 2, W * 3, T, o)];    // a high ceiling, so a hard throw comes back
    M.Composite.add(world, walls);
  }
  function place(b) { b.el.style.transform = 'translate(' + (b.position.x - b.w / 2) + 'px,' + (b.position.y - b.h / 2) + 'px) rotate(' + b.angle + 'rad)'; }
  function drop() {
    timers.forEach(clearTimeout); timers = [];
    bodies.forEach(function (b) { M.Composite.remove(world, b); }); bodies = [];
    S = scale(); sec.style.setProperty('--s', S); buildWalls();
    // smaller tiles fall a little slower, so they land the same way as on desktop instead of tumbling over
    engine.gravity.y = 1.25 * Math.max(.55, S);
    els.forEach(function (el, i) {
      el.classList.remove('is-on'); size(el);
      var w = el.offsetWidth, h = el.offsetHeight, k = Math.min(i, 2),
          m = Math.max(w / 2 + 16, Math.min(W - w / 2 - 16, W * X[k]));
      if (k === 0) m = Math.max(w / 2 + 40 * S, m);
      if (k === 2) m = Math.min(W - w / 2 - 40 * S, m);
      var r = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).borderTopLeftRadius) || 27 * S;
      var b = M.Bodies.rectangle(m, -h - 40, w, h, { chamfer: { radius: r }, restitution: .28, friction: .6, frictionAir: .01, density: .0016 });
      // on smaller screens the tiles are small next to the fall, so they get more inertia and air drag to land upright
      if (S < .6) { M.Body.setInertia(b, b.inertia * 4); b.frictionAir = .03; }
      b.el = el; b.w = w; b.h = h; M.Body.setAngle(b, ANGLE[k]); bodies.push(b); place(b);
      // the left four lands first, then the zero in the middle, then the right four
      timers.push(setTimeout(function () { M.Body.setAngularVelocity(b, SPIN[k]); M.Composite.add(world, b); el.classList.add('is-on'); }, AT[k]));
    });
  }
  M.Events.on(engine, 'afterUpdate', function () { bodies.forEach(place); });

  // Grab and throw. Touch only takes over when it starts on a tile, so the page still scrolls everywhere else.
  var mouse = M.Mouse.create(sec);
  ['mousewheel', 'DOMMouseScroll'].forEach(function (t) { sec.removeEventListener(t, mouse.mousewheel); });
  sec.removeEventListener('touchstart', mouse.mousedown);
  sec.removeEventListener('touchmove', mouse.mousemove);
  sec.removeEventListener('touchend', mouse.mouseup);
  var held = false;
  sec.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('.notfound-hero_tile')) { held = true; mouse.mousedown(e); } }, { passive: false });
  sec.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { if (held) mouse.mousemove(e); }, { passive: false });
  sec.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { if (held) { held = false; mouse.mouseup(e); } }, { passive: false });
  // keep hold of a tile dragged past the edge of the hero, and let go wherever the button is released
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { if (mouse.button === 0 && !sec.contains(e.target)) mouse.mousemove(e); });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) { if (mouse.button === 0 && !sec.contains(e.target)) mouse.mouseup(e); });
  var mc = M.MouseConstraint.create(engine, { mouse: mouse, constraint: { stiffness: .12, damping: .04, angularStiffness: 0, render: { visible: false } } });
  M.Composite.add(world, mc);
  M.Events.on(mc, 'startdrag', function (e) { if (e.body.el) { e.body.el.classList.add('is-grab'); sec.classList.add('is-grabbing'); } });
  M.Events.on(mc, 'enddrag', function (e) { if (e.body.el) e.body.el.classList.remove('is-grab'); sec.classList.remove('is-grabbing'); });

  var runner = M.Runner.create(); M.Runner.run(runner, engine);
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    clearTimeout(rt);
    rt = setTimeout(function () {
      if (Math.abs(scale() - S) > .04) { drop(); return; }
      buildWalls();
      bodies.forEach(function (b) { if (b.position.x > W) M.Body.setPosition(b, { x: W - b.w / 2, y: b.position.y }); });
    }, 150);
  });

  drop();
  requestAnimationFrame(function () { setTimeout(function () { sec.classList.add('is-in'); }, 60); });
})();
</script>
